channel.title: Onchain Report
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades across the blockchain industry.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes bug that could mint spendable XRP
item.description: XRPL fixed a flaw that could have created spendable XRP by exploiting a payment counting error, threatening the ledger’s 100 billion token supply cap.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes bug that could have created 18 trillion XRP
item.description: The XRP Ledger patched a payment bug that could have created spendable XRP beyond its 100 billion supply, closing a flaw developers say showed no signs of use.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House incumbents, including six with $1 million each, as the crypto industry looks to revive a stalled market rules bill in Congress.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, with $6 million earmarked for six as a Senate crypto rules bill remains stalled and industry eyes next Congress.

item.title: UK sanctions crypto exchanges over suspected Russia links
item.description: The UK sanctioned three crypto exchanges and two payment platforms over suspected Russia links, aiming to choke off routes used to move money around financial sanctions.

item.title: ESMA gives EU crypto platforms three months to clear stablecoins
item.description: ESMA says EU-authorised crypto firms should stop servicing non-MiCA stablecoins, while regulators must resolve existing holdings within three months.

item.title: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers for U.S. Galaxy users
item.description: Samsung will add USDC transfers to Wallet in late October, letting eligible U.S. Galaxy owners send money abroad or to bank accounts in 60-plus countries.

item.title: Oil rally sends bitcoin below $84,000 as liquidations hit $547 million
item.description: Bitcoin slipped below $84,000 as Brent topped $101 a barrel, while crypto liquidations rose 235% to $547 million and smaller tokens fell harder.

item.title: Ethereum tests near 200 million gas blocks on Sepolia
item.description: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade is producing Sepolia blocks with a limit near 200 million gas, giving developers an early test of higher network capacity.

item.title: FinCEN pulls crypto mixer rule over privacy concerns
item.description: FinCEN has withdrawn its 2023 crypto-mixing proposal, saying its broad scope risked chilling lawful privacy use and burdening financial firms with reporting rules.

item.title: Is Aibai right for your app’s crypto transfers?
item.description: Aibai may fit a crypto transfer flow, but only if its supported assets, networks, custody model and failure handling match what your app needs to serve real users.

item.title: Polymarket tests Protocol V2 with one positions contract
item.description: Polymarket has started live canary markets for Protocol V2, a rebuild that brings positions and pUSD collateral into a new system ahead of a planned November switch.

item.title: FinCEN drops crypto mixer rule over privacy concerns
item.description: FinCEN withdrew its 2023 crypto-mixing proposal, saying its broad scope could deter lawful privacy use and saddle financial firms with heavy reporting duties.

item.title: How to swap tokens from your wallet with cowswap
item.description: cowswap routes wallet token swaps through CoW Protocol batch auctions, where solvers settle trades with MEV protection and seek the best price across DEXs.

item.title: Solana Releases DvP Settlement Program With J.P. Morgan Input
item.description: Solana Foundation released an open-source settlement program shaped by J.P. Morgan input, aiming to let institutions swap assets and payment together on-chain.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake plans $1 million each for six House candidates and backs 26 more, as a Senate setback leaves crypto market rules unresolved before November’s midterms.

item.title: OKXICE files plan for 24/7 trading in over 60 stocks
item.description: OKXICE has filed plans for a 24/7 U.S. venue covering more than 60 tokenized stocks, a bid to bring blockchain-based share trading into regulated markets.

item.title: Five Decimal Checks for Cross-Chain Treasury Balances
item.description: Check token decimals, units and bridge records before comparing treasury balances across chains, so a display mismatch does not look like missing funds.

item.title: How to Trace BNB Chain Tokens From Pools to Wallets
item.description: Follow a pool swap, read token transfer events, and check each recipient address to see how BNB Chain tokens move from liquidity pools into wallets.

item.title: Will a BNB Chain Pool Handle Your Trade Size?
item.description: A BNB Chain pool can quote your trade and still deliver a worse price; check reserves, price impact, routing and slippage before you swap, because pool depth changes with every swap.
